change_summary: The notice is a retraction titled with the name "High-yield ethanol extraction of curcumin from turmeric", and the tracked paper has that same title. The article was retracted because the reported yields could not be reproduced and the raw data were found to have been altered. The paper's abstract reports that a single ethanol extraction recovered 94% of the curcumin in turmeric powder, and because the retraction applies to the whole paper, its reported yields, including that 94% recovery, cannot be relied on.
evaluation: The draft's reference list has no entry for "High-yield ethanol extraction of curcumin from turmeric" (2018), and the draft's text does not cite or name it.
recommendation: The article "High-yield ethanol extraction of curcumin from turmeric" was retracted because the reported yields could not be reproduced and the raw data were found to have been altered. The draft's reference list has no entry for "High-yield ethanol extraction of curcumin from turmeric" (2018), and the draft's text does not cite or name it. You don't need to change the draft, and you can dismiss this alert, but don't cite this paper as evidence in future revisions.
